intro.heading: The matchup
intro.body:
One game left, and this one is about the finish. **Klein Cain (5-4, 3-4)** closes the regular season at **Klein Forest (1-8, 1-6)** on Friday, November 6 at 7:00 PM at Klein Memorial Stadium. Thursday's loss to Magnolia ended Cain's playoff chase, so the finale carries a simpler stake: beat the Golden Eagles, finish **6-4**, and send the seniors out with a winning season.

The math closed Thursday night. Cain sits **sixth** in **District 15-6A**, and only the **top four** advance to the playoffs. Magnolia (5-2) and Klein were already beyond Cain's best possible district finish of **4-4** on Thursday, and Friday night's games filled in the rest of the picture. **Klein (7-1)** routed Klein Collins **71-21** and locked up **first place**. **Klein Oak (5-2)** shut out Magnolia West **55-0**, and **Tomball (5-2)** beat Tomball Memorial **47-26**, so Oak and Tomball joined Magnolia in a **three-way tie for second**. **Klein Collins (4-3)** is the one team still chasing a spot: the Tigers play at Klein Oak on Thursday, and Magnolia hosts Tomball on Friday, and those two games settle the last playoff spots and the seeding behind Klein. None of it changes Cain's week. The finale is the Hurricanes' game alone.

Klein Forest comes in off its bye week on a **five-game losing streak**. Its last outing was a **48-20** loss at Magnolia on October 23, and its lone win was a **43-42** shootout over Magnolia West on September 17. Running back **Dejaune Etheridge** is the offense either way: he ran for **200 yards and three touchdowns** in the win over Magnolia West and scored all three Forest touchdowns against Magnolia. The Golden Eagles have given up **407 points in nine games**, but a team playing its finale at home with nothing to lose is never a formality.

Cain averages **36.1 points a game** and has played its best football in bursts this season. Neither team appeared in the **October 26** Class 6A state poll from Dave Campbell's Texas Football. For Cain's seniors, Friday is the last game of their high school careers, and a win still sends them out the right way: **6-4**, a winning season, and a victory in the finale. *One more Friday night. Finish it right.*
